Compute the standard Saint-Venant isentropic flow parameter ratios for a subsonic flow at Mach number M = 0.5.
Use air as the working fluid with specific heat ratio γ = 1.4.
Calculate the following isentropic relations as explicit numerical values:
Stagnation-to-static temperature ratio T0/T = 1 + (γ−1)/2 · M².
Stagnation-to-static pressure ratio p0/p = [1 + (γ−1)/2 · M²]^(γ/(γ−1)).
Stagnation-to-static density ratio ρ0/ρ = [1 + (γ−1)/2 · M²]^(1/(γ−1)).
Critical-area ratio A/A* = (1/M) · [(1 + (γ−1)/2 · M²) / ((γ+1)/2)]^((γ+1)/(2(γ−1))).
Do not apply the Rayleigh-Pitot (normal-shock) formula, as the flow is subsonic and no shock is present.
State the method used (isentropic / Saint-Venant) explicitly in the answer to distinguish it from the Rayleigh-Pitot approach.
